question: For each customer, list their top 3 genres by total spending
sql:
WITH CustomerGenreSpend AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerId,
         c.FirstName,
         c.LastName,
         g.Name AS Genre,
         SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSpending,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC) AS rn
  FROM Customer c
  JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
  JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, g.Name
)
SELECT FirstName, LastName, Genre, TotalSpending
FROM CustomerGenreSpend
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY LastName, FirstName, TotalSpending DESC;

question: Which customers have purchased tracks from every genre that 'AC/DC' has tracks in?

FROM Customer c
JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
JOIN InvoiceLine il ON i.InvoiceId = il.InvoiceId
JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId
WHERE t.GenreId IN (
  SELECT t2.GenreId
  FROM Artist a
  JOIN Album al ON a.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
  JOIN Track t2 ON al.AlbumId = t2.AlbumId
  WHERE a.Name = 'AC/DC'
)

  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t3.GenreId)

  JOIN Album al3 ON a3.ArtistId = al3.ArtistId

  WHERE a3.Name = 'AC/DC'
);

question: For each customer, list their top 3 genres by total spending
sql:
WITH CustomerGenreSpend AS (
  SELECT c.CustomerId,
         c.FirstName,
         c.LastName,
         g.Name AS Genre,
         SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) AS TotalSpent,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity) DESC) AS rn
  FROM Customer c
  JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
  JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  JOIN Track t ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
  JOIN Genre g ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
  GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName, g.Name
)
SELECT FirstName, LastName, Genre, TotalSpent
FROM CustomerGenreSpend
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY LastName, FirstName, TotalSpent DESC;
